caption: The drawing features a stylized eagle with outstretched wings at the center, set against a solid dark blue background. The eagle is depicted in shades of cream and rust red, with blue and red accents on its wings, body, and head. The eagle's talons are visible, and it is surrounded by a circular border made up of a repeating chain-like pattern in russet orange. Inside the circle, the eagle is encircled by several evenly spaced, eight-pointed stars in shades of red and off-white. The bottom portion of the circle contains a denser grouping of off-white stars directly below the eagle. The artist's signature "Ruth M. Barnes" appears in the lower right corner, and a number "L1244" is written in the lower left outside the main image area. The composition is symmetrical, with all elements contained within the main circular border set on a square blue field, further bordered by a light beige margin.
title: Historic Coverlet
